response.sql: SELECT SUM(per_customer.rental_count) AS total_rentals FROM (SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS rental_count FROM rental WHERE CAST(return_date AS CHAR) BETWEEN '2005-07-13 08:35:51' AND '2005-08-09 05:58:16' GROUP BY customer_id) AS per_customer;

assumptions.assumption: Comparing return_date as text means casting the DATETIME to CHAR, using MySQL's 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' rendering, so the string bounds are compared lexicographically with inclusive endpoints. Rows with NULL return_date are excluded because BETWEEN is never true for NULL.
Each rental row is one rental, so the sum of per-customer counts equals the total number of matching rental rows. customer_id is NOT NULL, so no rows are dropped by the grouping.
